verses.text: \s1 Na kahring sak e Cathut Lawk
Apuengcue hoi kaawm e, kaimouh ni khei ka thai awh e, mit hoi khei ka hmu awh e, kut hoi khei katek awh e, hringnae lawk hah nangmouh koe ka pâpho awh.

Hote hringnae teh yo a kamnue toe. Kaimouh ni hai ka hmu awh toe. Pa hoi rei kaawm niteh maimouh koe ka kamnuek e, hote yungyoe hringnae hah, kaimouh ni nangmouh koe ka kampangkhai awh teh ka pâpho awh.
Kaimouh teh Pa hoi hai, Capa Jisuh Khrih hoi hai, huikonae ka tawn awh dawkvah, nangmouh ni kaimouh hoi huikonae na tawn awh nahanelah, ka thai awh e naw hah nangmouh koe ka pâpho awh.

Nange lunghawinae a kuep nahanelah, hete canaw hah ka thut awh.   
\s1 Angnae dawk khoktakannae
Hote lawk hah ahni koehoi ka thai awh teh, nangmouh koe ka pâpho awh e teh, Cathut teh angnae lah ao.
Cathut dawk hmonae khoeroe awmhoeh. Maimouh ni Cathut hoi huikonae ka tawn toe ti awh lahun navah, hmonae dawk hring awh pawiteh, lawkkatang dawk hring awh hoeh. Laithoe doeh dei awh.

Cathut teh angnae dawk ao e patetlah maimouh ni angnae dawk hring awh pawiteh, buet touh hoi buet touh huiko lah o awh. Cathut Capa, Jisuh Khrih e thi ni, maimae yon kaawm e naw pueng hah a pâsu teh a thoungsak toe.
Maimouh ni ka yon hoeh tet awh pawiteh, mahoima kâdum awh. Maimouh dawk lawkkatang awmhoeh.
Maimouh ni mamae yonpâpho awh pawiteh, Cathut teh maimae yonnae pueng hoi sakpayon e naw pueng, ngaithoum hane hoi lanhoehnae pueng thoungsak hanelah, a lawkkam a cak.
Maimouh ni yonnae ka sak hoeh tet awh pawiteh, ama hah laithoe sak awh. A lawk hai maimouh dawk awmhoeh.

Ka pahren e canaw, yonnae na sak awh hoeh nahanelah, hete ca hah ka thut teh na patawn awh. Tami buetbuet touh ni yonnae sakpayon pawiteh, maimouh na kampangkhai hanelah kalan e Bawipa Jisuh Khrih teh Pa koe ao.

Hote Bawipa teh maimae yon dueng nahoeh, talaivan pueng e yontha nahanelah, thueng e lah ao.   
\s1 Khrih e kâlawknaw
Hote Bawipa teh maimouh ni bangtelah hoi maw panue awh tetpawiteh, kâpoelawknaw hah tarawi e lahoi panue awh.
Kâpoelawknaw hah tarawi laipalah, Bawipa ka panue toe ka tet e tami teh, a lai kathoute lah doeh o awh. Ahni dawk lawkkatang awmhoeh.
Hote Bawipa lawk hah ka tarawi e teh, Cathut e a lungpatawnae hoi akawi katang. Maimouh ni hote Bawipa dawk o awh e hah het telah hoi panue awh.
Hote Bawipa dawk ka hring toe ka tet e tami teh, Jisuh ni a sak e patetlah a dawn van han.

Ka lungpataw e ka huinaw: nangmouh koe ka thut e kâpoelawk hateh, a katha e na hoeh. Ahmaloe hoi kaawm tangcoung e kâpoelawk hah doeh. Ahmaloe hoi kaawm tangcoung e kâpoelawk hateh na thai awh tangcoung e lawk hah doeh.

Atuvah kâpoelawk katha hah nangmouh koevah ka thut. Hote kâpoelawk teh, Bawipa dawk nakunghai, nangmouh dawk nakunghai, hmu katang e lah ao. Bangkongtetpawiteh, hmonae teh a kahma teh angnae katang teh coungkacoelah a ang toe.
Hmaunawngha hah na hmuhma lahun nah, kai teh angnae dawk ka o ka tet e tami teh, atu sittouh hmonae thung doeh ao rah.
Hmaunawngha lungpataw e tami teh angnae dawk kahring e lah ao. Kamthui teh rawp nahane ahni dawk awmhoeh.

Hmaunawngha kahmawt ngai hoeh e tami teh, hmonae dawk kaawm niteh hmonae dawk doeh a hring rah. Hmonae ni a mit a dawn sak teh, na maw ka cei tie hai panuek hoeh.   
\s1 Canaw, napanaw, thoundounnaw
Ka lungpataw e canaw: nangmouh teh hote Bawipa min lahoi yon thoungsak lah na o awh toung dawkvah, hete ca ka thut teh na patawn awh.

Apanaw: nangmouh teh apuengcue hoi kaawm tangcoung e hah, na panue awh dawkvah, hete ca ka thut teh na patawn awh. Thoundounnaw: nangmouh teh, kahrai hah na tâ awh dawkvah hete ca ka thut teh na patawn awh. Camonaw: nangmouh teh Pa hah na panue awh dawkvah hete ca ka thut teh na patawn awh.

Napanaw: nangmouh ni apuengcue hoi kaawm tangcoung e hah, na panue awh dawkvah hete ca ka thut teh na patawn awh. Thoundounnaw: nangmouh na thasai awh teh, Cathut lawk na thung a hring teh, kahrai hah na tâ awh dawkvah, hete ca ka thut teh na patawn awh.   
\s1 Talai hoi talai hno lungpataw hanh
Talaivan hoi talaivan dawk kaawm e hnonaw hah lungpataw awh hanh. Talai lungpataw e teh, Pa lungpatawnae tawn hoeh.
Talaivan dawk kaawm e hnonaw teh: takngainae, mitnoenae, talai hno dawk kâoupnae hah doeh. Hotnaw teh, Pa koehoi ka tho e nahoeh. Talai lahoi ka tho e doeh.

Talaivan hoi talaivan hno noenae teh kahmat han. Cathut ngainae patetlah ka tarawi e tami teh a yungyoe a kangning.   
\s1 A hnukteng e tueng

Ka lungpataw e canaw: atu e tueng teh, a hnukteng e atueng lah ao. Khrih e a taran khrihkaphawk a tâco e na thai awh e patetlah atu rawraw khrihkaphawknaw moi ao toe. Hatdawkvah, atu e tueng teh a hnukteng e atueng doeh toe tie panue thai.

Ahnimanaw teh, maimouh koehoi a tâco awh teh, a cei awh toe. Hatei, ahmaloe hoi maimouh hoi kâkuen awh hoeh. Maimouh hoi kâkuen awh pawiteh maimouh hoi doeh rei awm a tih. Maimouh hoi kâkuen awh hoeh tie hah a kamnue nahanelah, maimouh koehoi a tâco awh toe.
Nangmouh teh, kathounge Cathut kut dawk hoi, satui awi lah na o awh. Hno cawngca pueng teh na panue awh.
Lawkkatang na panue awh hoeh dawk ca na patawn awh e na hoeh. Nangmouh ni na panue awh teh, laithoe e pueng teh lawkkatang hoi kâkuen hoeh tie na panue awh dawkvah ca na patawn awh e doeh ka tho.

Laithoe ka dei e teh apimaw. Jisuh teh Khrih nahoeh ka tet e tami hah doeh. Pa hoi Capa ka taran e teh khrihkaphawk doeh.   
\s1 Cathut dawk kamtue awh
Capa ka taran e tami teh, Pa panuek hoeh. Capa ka dâw e tami teh Pa hah a panue.
Hatdawkvah, ahmaloe hoi na thai awh e phung lawk hah nangmouh dawk hring sak awh. Hote phung lawk teh, nangmouh dawk hring pawiteh, nangmouh teh Capa hoi Pa dawk kahring e lah na o awh han.
Maimouh koe, na poe e lawkkam teh, a yungyoe hringnae hah doeh.
Nangmouh na ka dum e naw e a kong teh, hettelah kathut teh na patawn awh.

Cathut koehoi na coe awh e satui awi lungmanae teh nangmouh dawk a hring dawkvah nangmouh teh apinihai bout cangkhai ngai hoeh toe. Hote satui awi lungmanae teh laithoe e nahoeh. A katang e na cangkhai dawkvah, na cangkhai e patetlah nangmouh ni Capa dawk hring awh.   
\s1 Cathut e canaw
Ka lungpataw e canaw : Capa a kamnue toteh, maimouh hai ama koe pha awh toteh, taranhawi laihoi, kayanae ao hoeh nahanelah, Capa dawk pou hring awh.
Cathut teh a lan tie na panuek awh pawiteh, lannae ka sak e tami pueng hah Cathut ni a khe e doeh tie teh panue awh.
Cathut e canaw telah kaw e lah o awh nahanelah, Cathut ni maimouh banghloimaw lungpataw awh, tie hah pouk a haw! Talai taminaw ni Cathut hah a panue awh hoeh dawkvah, maimouh hai na panuek awh hoeh.

Ka lungpataw e naw : atuvah maimouh teh Cathut e ca lah o awh. Ato hmalah teh bangtelamaw o awh han tie hah kamnuek hoeh rah. Hatei Bawipa Jisuh ama a kamnue toteh, ama hoi kâvan awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Bawipa ama a coung e patetlah hmu awh han.
Hottelah, ka ngaihawi e tami teh Bawipa a thoung e patetlah amahoima a kamthoung.
Yonnae ka sak e tami teh kâlawk a ek. Sak payonnae teh kâlawk eknae doeh.
Bawipa ni maimae yonnae pueng ceikhai hanelah a tho toe tie hah na panue awh. Bawipa dawk yonnae awm hoeh.
Bawipa dawk kahring e tami teh, yonnae pou sak hoeh. Yonnae pou ka sak e tami teh, Bawipa hah hmawt hoeh rah.
Ka canaw: apihai kâdum sak awh hanh. Apihai lannae nuen ka tarawi e teh Bawipa a lan e patetlah a lan.
Kahraimathout teh ahmaloe hoi yonnae ka sak e lah ao dawkvah, apipatet hai yonnae ka sak e teh kahraimathout hoi a kâkuet. Cathut Capa a tho ngainae teh kahraimathout thaw tawk raphoe pouh hane doeh.

Cathut ni a khe e tami teh, yonnae pou sak hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahni dawk Cathut e cati a o. Ahni teh, Cathut ni a khe e lah ao dawkvah, yonnae pou sak thai hoeh.   
\s1 Buet touh hoi buet touh lungkâpataw awh
Hot patetlah e noutnae lahoi yah, Cathut e a canaw hoi kahraimathout e a canaw teh a kamnue awh. Lannae ka tarawi hoeh e, mae hmaunawngha lungpataw hoeh e teh, Cathut hoi kâkuen hoeh.
Nangmouh ni hmaloe hoi na thai a tangcoung e kamthang kahawi hateh, buet touh hoi buet touh lungkâpataw awh han tie hah doeh.
Kahrai hoi kâkuen niteh a nawngha ka thet e Kain patetlah awm hanh awh. Kain ni bangkongmaw a nawngha a thei tetpawiteh, amae tawksak e teh lan hoeh, a nawngha e tawksak e teh a lan dawk doeh.
Hmaunawngha naw: talaivan taminaw ni na ka hmawt ngaihoeh nakunghai, na kângairu awh hanh.
Maimouh teh hmaunawngha reira lungkâpataw awh dawkvah, duenae koehoi hringnae koe lah, raka awh toe tie kâpanue awh. Ma e hmaunawngha lungpataw hoeh e tami teh, duenae dawk doeh a hring rah.

Ma e hmaunawngha lung ka pataw hoeh e tami teh, tami ka thet e lah doeh ao. Tami ka thet e tami buet touh dawk boehai, a yungyoe hringnae awmhoeh tie hah nangmouh ni na panue awh.   
\s1 Tawknae lahoi lungpatawnae
Khrih ni maimouh hane kecu dawk, a hringnae a pasoung e khet navah, a lungpatawnae hah panue awh. Maimouh ni hai hmaunawngha reira hanelah, hringnae pasoung hanlah ao.
Apipatethai talaivan hnopai a tawn nahlangva vah, a hmaunawngha a roedeng e hah a hmu ei, paawt pawiteh, ahni dawk Cathut lungpatawnae bangtelamaw khuet ao han vaw.
Canaw: maimouh teh lawk hrawng hoi dueng laipalah, tawksaknae hoi lawkkatang lahoi lungpataw awh sei.
Hottelah lungpataw awh pawiteh, lawkkatang hoi kâkuet awh toe tie hah na panuek awh vaiteh, mamae lung ni yon na kapen nakunghai, Cathut hmalah lungtangnae ao sak han.
Cathut teh maimae lung hlak a len dawkvah, hnocawngca pueng a panue.
Ka lungpataw e naw : mae lung ni yon na pen awh hoehpawiteh, Cathut hmalah taranhawinae teh tawn awh toe.
Maimouh ni kâpoelawknaw ngâi awh teh, a ngai e patetlah tarawi awh pawiteh, ratoum awh e pueng Cathut koehoi hmu awh han.
Cathut e kâpoelawk tie hateh Capa Jisuh Khrih min yuem han tie hoi ahni ni na dei pouh e patetlah buet touh hoi buet touh lungkâpataw awh han tie hah doeh.
Kâpoelawknaw ka tarawi e tami teh, Cathut thung ao teh, ahnimouh thung Cathut ao. Maimouh koe na poe e Kathoung Muitha lahoi, Cathut teh maimouh dawk ao tie panue awh.
\s1 Cathut Muitha hoi khrihkaphawk e muitha

Ka lungpataw e naw, muitha pueng hah yuem awh hanh. Cathut koehoi ka tho e maw, ka tho hoeh e maw tie tanouk awh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, moikapap e profetkaphawknaw teh het talaivan vah a kamthaw awh toe.
Cathut e Muitha hah bangtelah hoi maw panue awh han tetpawiteh, tami lahoi ka tho e Jisuh Khrih ka dâw e muitha hateh, Cathut koehoi ka tho e doeh.

Tami lahoi ka tho e Jisuh Khrih ka dâw hoeh e muitha hateh, Cathut koehoi ka tho e nahoeh. Hot patet e muitha hateh, na thai awh tangcoung e patetlah, het talaivan tho awh vaiteh, atu patenghai ka tho lahun niteh coungkacoelah kaawm e khrihkaphawk e muitha doeh.
Ka canaw : Nangmouh teh, Cathut hoi kâkuen e lah na o awh. Hotnaw hai na tâ awh toe. Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh koe lah kaawm e hateh, talaivan koe lah kaawm e hlak hoe a len.
Ahnimouh teh talaivan lae a tho awh dawkvah, talai e konglam hah ouk a dei awh. Talai taminaw nihai ahnimae lawk hah ouk a ngai awh.

Maimouh teh, Cathut e lah doeh o awh. Cathut ka panuek e niteh, maimae lawk hah a ngâi awh. Cathut hoi kâkuen hoeh e niteh, maimae lawk hah ngâi awh hoeh. Hote hnonaw khet lahoi yah, lawkkatang muitha hoi muitha kaphawk tie hah panue awh.   
\s1 Lungkâpatawnae lahoi Cathut panuenae

Ka pahren e naw : buet touh hoi buet touh lungpataw awh sei. Bangkongtetpawiteh, lungpatawnae teh Cathut e doeh. Lungpatawnae ka tawn e tami teh Cathut ni a khe e lah ao teh, Cathut ka panuek e lahai ao.
Lungpatawnae ka tawn hoeh e tami teh, Cathut panuek hoeh. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut teh lungpatawnae lah ao.

Cathut ni maimouh lungpatawnae a kamnue sak e teh, Capa lahoi maimouh hring awh nahanelah, a tawn dueng e Capa het talaivan a patoun e dawkvah a kamnue sak. Hmu thai e hmaunawngha patenghai lungpataw hoehpawiteh, hmu thai hoeh e Cathut na tawng teh, bangtelamaw a lungpataw thai han.

Maimouh ni Cathut lungpataw awh toe tie na hoeh. Cathut ni maimouh lung na pataw awh, maimae yon tha lah ao nahan Capa a patoun e dawkvah a lungpatawnae teh ao.   
\s1 Lungpatawnae a bawilen
Ka pahren e naw: Cathut ni maimouh hettelah totouh lung na pataw pawiteh, maimouh hai buet touh hoi buet touh lungkapataw awh hanlah ao.
Cathut teh apinihai nâtuek hai hmawt boihoeh. Buet touh hoi buet touh lungpataw awh pawiteh, Cathut ni maimouh dawk awm vaiteh, maimouh teh lungpatawnae hoi kawi awh han.
Cathut ni a Muitha na poe awh e lahoi yah, maimouh teh Cathut dawk o awh e hoi Cathut maimouh dawk ao e hah panue awh.
Talaivan taminaw ka Rungngangkung lah a coung sak nahan, Pa ni Capa a patoun e hah maimouh ni hmu awh teh kampangkhai awh.
Jisuh teh Cathut Capa doeh tie ka kampangkhai e tami dawk Cathut ao teh ahni hai Cathut dawk ao.
Cathut ni maimouh lungpataw e hah panue teh yuem awh. Cathut teh lungpatawnae lah ao. Lungpatawnae dawk ka hring e tami teh Cathut dawk a hring. Cathut hai ahni dawk a hring.
Maimouh teh lungpatawnae hoi kawi awh dawkvah, lawkcengnae hmalah taranhawi awh han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, maimouh teh het talaivan vah Bawipa ama patetlah doeh hring awh.
Lungpatawnae dawkvah takinae awm hoeh. Lungpatawnae niteh takinae pueng a takhoe. Bangkongtetpawiteh, takinae teh rek lah ao toe. Ka taket e tami teh lungpatawnae hoi kawi hoeh rah.

Cathut ni hmaloe hoi lung na pataw awh dawkvah, maimouh nihai lungpataw awh.   
\s1 Cathut e kâlawknaw tarawinae

Apipatethai Cathut ka lungpataw toe ati nahlangva, a hmaunawngha hmuhma pawiteh a laithoe doeh a dei. Hmu thai e hmaunawngha patenghai, lungpataw hoehpawiteh, mit ni hmu thai hoeh e Cathut na tawng teh bangtelamaw lungpataw thai han vaw.
Cathut lungpataw e tami niteh, a hmaunawngha hai lungpataw van han tie kâlawk teh Khrih koehoi maimouh ni coe awh toe.
Jisuh teh Khrih doeh tie kayueme tami pueng teh Cathut ni a khe e lah ao. Apipatethai Pa lungpataw e teh Capa hai a lungpataw van.
Maimouh ni Cathut hah lungpataw awh teh, a kâpoelawknaw hah tarawi awh pawiteh, Cathut e a canaw lungpataw awh tie panue awh.
Kâpoelawknaw tarawinae teh, Cathut lungpataw e lah ao. Amae kâpoelawknaw teh hnori phu saknae nahoeh.
Cathut e ca lah kaawm e tami teh talai hah a tâ. Talaivan a tânae hateh, maimae yuemnae hah doeh.

Jisuh teh Cathut capa doeh tie ka yuem e tami ni dueng doeh talaivan a tâ.   
\s1 Jisuh yuemkamcu
Hote Bawipa teh tui hoi thi hoi ka tho e Jisuh Khrih hah doeh. Tui hoi dueng nahoeh, tui hoi thi hoi doeh a tho. Kapanuekkhaikung Muitha hateh lawkkatang Muitha doeh.
Kalvan vah kapanuekkhaikung kathum touh Pa, Lawk, hoi Kathoung Muitha ao. Hote kathum touh teh buet touh lah ao awh.
Talai van hai kapanuekkhaikung kathum touh Muitha, Tui, hoi Thi ao. Hote kathum touh teh a kânging awh.
Maimouh ni tami e panuekhainae hah yuem awh pawiteh Cathut e panuekhainae hateh hoe yuem hanelah ao. Hote panuekhainae teh Cathut ni a Capa na poe awh e kong hah doeh.

Cathut e Capa hah ka yuem e tami teh a thungvah hote kapanuekkhaikung hah a tawn. Cathut hah ka yuem hoeh e tami teh Cathut hah laithoe, yon a pen. Bangtelamaw tetpawiteh Cathut ni amae Capa kong a kampangkhai e hah ahni ni yuem laipalah ao dawkvah.
Panuekhainae hateh Cathut ni maimouh hah yungyoe hringnae na poe awh. Hote hringnae hateh Capa dawk ao.
Capa ka tawn e tami teh hringnae a tawn toe. Capa ka yuem hoeh e tami teh hringnae tawn hoeh.

Cathut Capa e min ka yuem e pueng ni yungyoe hringnae na tawn awh toe tie namahoima na kâpanue awh nahanlah hete canaw hah ka thut teh na patawn awh.   
\s1 Hmakacawne ratoumnae
Maimouh ni Cathut ni a ngai e patetlah hno buetbuet touh het awh pawiteh, Cathut ni na thai pouh tie hah panue awh.
Hahoi, Cathut koe hei awh e pueng na thai pouh tie panuek awh pawiteh, a ma koe hei e pueng teh hmu awh toe tie hah panue awh.

Hmaunawngha ni duenae koe ka phatkhai hoeh e yonnae a sakpayon e hah, tami buetbuet touh ni hmawt pawiteh ratoum naseh. Duenae koe ka phatkhai hoeh e yonnae ka sak e hmaunawngha hah Cathut ni hringnae a poe han. Duenae koe ka phatkhai e yonnae ao. Hot patet e yonnae hanlah ratoum na seh ka tie na hoeh.

Lanhoehnae pueng hateh yonnae doeh. Hatei, duenae koe kaphatkhai hoeh e yonnae ao.   
\s1 Pâpoutnae
Cathut e ca lah kaawm e pueng ni yonnae pou sak awh hoeh. Cathut ni a khe e tami teh Cathut ma ni a okhai dawkvah, kahrai ni runae poe thai hoeh.
Maimouh teh Cathut ca lah o awh tie hoi talaivan pueng teh kahrai kut dawk ao awh tie hah panue awh.

Cathut Capa a tho toe tie hoi, ama teh Cathut katang doeh ti panuethainae hai na poe awh tie panue awh. Cathut katang dawk hai thoseh, Capa Jisuh Khrih dawk hai thoseh, maimouh teh o awh. Ahni teh Cathut katang doeh.A yungyoe hringnae lahai ao.
Ka canaw, meikaphawknaw hah roun awh.
